narrative.overview: Scoped extension for the approved app-wide light motif and deck-practice update. DESIGN.md remains the complete incumbent brand specification; this sidecar does not replace unrelated existing components. Color primitives live only in its frontmatter. Component snippets are static style translations of Flutter output, not a second practice implementation.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial ground with persisted Automatic / Light / Dark motifs; dark keeps the near-black identity.
Serif for anything the learner reads as content; sans for anything that is app chrome.
dos: Do resolve semantic colors through the current theme; motif changes preserve navigation and editing state.
donts: Don’t persist red feedback outside its exercise attempt: choice chips flash; deck input keeps its first checked feedback until the next text edit.
